paper_metadata.title: Role of Rhenium in Single Crystal Ni-based Superalloys

evidence.quote: The effect of rhenium on the microstructure and mechanical properties of single crystal superalloys with a nominal composition of Ni-3Cr-12Co-1Mo-6W-6Al-8Ta-0.1Hf-(0, 2, 4) Re has been studied.
Table 1 Incipient melting point and heat treatment process of 0Re, 2Re and 4Re alloy
It can be seen that the addition of 2 wt.% Re does not heighten the incipient melting point, while 4 wt.% Re elevates that significantly.
